name: Wald §4.4 Linearised Riemann Tensor
source: Wald, R.M. (1984). General Relativity. University of Chicago Press, §4.4. The linearised Riemann tensor R^(1)_{μνρσ} = (1/2)(∂_ν∂_ρ h_{μσ} + ∂_μ∂_σ h_{νρ} - ∂_μ∂_ρ h_{νσ} - ∂_ν∂_σ h_{μρ}). Local: ../generalrelativity/Literature/Robert M. Wald-General Relativity-University of Chicago Press (1984).djvu
notes: Source is .djvu format (text extraction requires djvulibre-bin, not currently installed). Ground truth: §4.4 'Linearized gravity' contains the standard linearized Riemann tensor formula R^(1)_{abcd} = (1/2)(∂_b∂_c h_{ad} + ∂_a∂_d h_{bc} - ∂_a∂_c h_{bd} - ∂_b∂_d h_{ac}). Cross-verified against Zee (2013) §IX.4 eq.(1) which gives the contracted (Ricci) version.
